compound deva+kula, accusative singular neuter destination

items.question: Where should the practitioner go after performing the prescribed worship and mantra recitation?
premises: Worship and mantra recitation precede movement.
Temple or own house are destinations.
items.inference: After worship one should go to a temple or to one's own excellent house.
uncertainties: Exact ritual context of the movement remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: One should go to a temple, or even to one's own excellent house.
